css:
.cvtile { flex:1; background:#fff; border:2px solid #ded8c8; border-radius:14px;
          padding:9.5px 5px; text-align:center; }

.cvty { font-size:13.5px; font-weight:700; margin-top:3px; padding-top:3px;
        border-top:1.5px dashed #e6e0d0; white-space:nowrap; }

.cvtcap { width:100%; text-align:center; font-size:14.5px; color:#8a8372;
          font-weight:700; margin-bottom:1px; }

/* THE TILE LABEL WAS UNDER THE PRINT FLOOR.
   `.cvtl` was 14px, which is 10.3px at the 0.734 print zoom —
   below the 11px minimum step15 enforces, on a label that carries
   real counts, not decoration. 15.2px prints at 11.2px.
   `i` is set ABOVE every other rule in this file on purpose: the
   bundle emits rules in `i` order and both selectors are equally
   specific, so a lower number loses to the 14px rule it is meant
   to replace. The first attempt used 90 and did nothing.
   Only this element is touched — `.cvtl` appears zero times in
   either tested physics chapter, so no verified pagination moves.
   NOTE: no Hindi is quoted in this comment. Quoting the label's
   own text here made it match a search for that text on the page,
   which cost a wrong diagnosis. */
.cvtl { font-size:15.2px; }
